title: Identity & Model Entitlement
summary: Resolves the calling user, verifies the API key, and rejects any model that is not explicitly named on the caller’s API Product.
onViolation: HTTP 401 / 403 — request never reaches a model

policies.name: DJWT-ExtractUserIdentity
policies.purpose: Extracts the end-user identity from the Cloud IAP / Bearer token for per-user attribution.

policies.name: VA-VerifyAPIKey
policies.purpose: Validates the consumer key and loads the persona API Product (Engineering & IT, Analysts, Customer Support & Sales).

policies.name: OAS-ValidateRequest
policies.purpose: Validates the OpenAPI 3.0 request structure and enforces named model entitlements (no wildcards).

title: Prompt & Response Safety
summary: Screens every prompt before a token is spent and inspects every completion on the way out, using one enterprise Model Armor template across all providers.
onViolation: HTTP 400 — blocked at the perimeter with a safety reason

policies.name: SUP-UserPrompt
policies.purpose: Scans the incoming prompt for injection, jailbreak, and PII before any LLM invocation.

policies.name: SMR-SanitizeModelResponse
policies.purpose: Inspects the model output to redact sensitive PII or unsafe completions.

title: Semantic Cache
summary: Matches semantically equivalent prompts against a vector cache and serves them without an upstream call — zero model cost, zero token quota.
onViolation: No rejection — a hit short-circuits the upstream call
configSource: Similarity threshold & TTL on the cache policy

policies.name: SCL-Semantic-Cache-Lookup
policies.purpose: Embeds the incoming prompt and queries the vector store for a high-similarity match.

policies.name: SCP-Semantic-Cache-Populate
policies.purpose: Stores the LLM response on a cache miss so later similar prompts are served locally.

title: Smart Routing Model Mapping
summary: Classifies each prompt with the TypeSafe AI JEV System One router model and maps the result to a concrete model the caller is entitled to — no model names hardcoded in the proxy.
attachPoint: AutoRoutingFlow (/auto route, after the semantic cache lookup — cache misses only)
onViolation: Fails open — falls back to the product default model
configSource: API Product routing.model.* custom attributes + encrypted ai-gateway-creds KVM (router API key)

policies.name: KVM-GetRouterCredentials
policies.purpose: Reads the router API key from the encrypted ai-gateway-creds KVM into a private.* variable.

policies.name: AM-PrepRouterRequest
policies.purpose: Builds the classifier request natively and constrains the answer to coding | deep_reasoning | simple | general.

policies.name: SC-ModelRouter
policies.purpose: Calls the JEV System One router with a 2.5s timeout and continue-on-error so a blip degrades rather than fails.

policies.name: JS-AutoRouting
policies.purpose: Maps the returned category to a model using the API Product attributes. Holds no model names of its own.

policies.name: AM-RouteGeminiTarget
policies.purpose: Routes the request to the selected Vertex AI Gemini endpoint.

policies.name: AM-RouteClaudeTarget
policies.purpose: Routes coding prompts to Anthropic Claude on Vertex when the persona product maps coding to Claude.

title: Token Quotas & Spend Limits
summary: Budgets by tokens and dollars rather than requests, and checks the prepaid wallet plus active rate plan before the call is allowed through.
onViolation: HTTP 429 token quota or $ budget exceeded / HTTP 403 wallet exhausted
configSource: API Product token quota + developer.budget.* attributes + wallet balance & rate plan

policies.name: LTQ-TokenEnforce
policies.purpose: Checks accumulated token consumption against the limit resolved from the API Product (token-quota demo model route, and /auto before the router runs).

policies.name: LTQ-TokenCount
policies.purpose: Reads the exact token count from the model response and increments the distributed counter.

policies.name: QC-EnforceBudgetLimit
policies.purpose: Checks the per-developer USD budget counter; RF-BudgetExceeded raises the client-facing 429.

policies.name: QC-DeductBudget
policies.purpose: Spends the real request cost (micro-dollars) against the budget counter; skipped on cache hits.

policies.name: MLC-EnforceMonetizationLimits
policies.purpose: Verifies the prepaid wallet balance and an active rate plan subscription.

title: Cost Attribution & Telemetry
summary: Prices every request from the live rate card and emits the analytics dimensions and x-gateway-* trace headers the dashboards run on.

policies.name: KVM-GetModelRates
policies.purpose: Reads the live input/output per-1k token rates from the ai-model-rates KVM.

policies.name: JS-CalculateCost
policies.purpose: Computes the exact USD cost for the request (zeroed on a cache hit) that QC-DeductBudget then spends.

policies.name: DC-ModelAnalytics
policies.purpose: Streams model, token counts, latency, and cost into custom analytics dimensions.

policies.name: AM-SetResponseHeaders
policies.purpose: Injects the x-gateway-* trace headers used by the trace viewer.

title: Agent API Key Check
summary: Parses the JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope, rejects non-MCP methods, and verifies the agent’s API key on tools/list and tools/call before anything else runs.
onViolation: HTTP 401 unauthorized (bad key) / HTTP 400 (method not allowed)

policies.name: CORS-Allow
policies.purpose: Enables cross-origin browser and web-agent inspection.

policies.name: PP-MCP
policies.purpose: Parses the incoming JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope (jsonrpc, id, method, params).

policies.name: RF-MethodNotAllowed
policies.purpose: Rejects JSON-RPC methods outside the MCP allowlist with HTTP 400 / -32601.

policies.name: VA-VerifyAPIKey
policies.purpose: Verifies the agent consumer key on tools/list and tools/call.

title: Persona Tools Filter
summary: Only tools listed as tools/call/<tool> operations on the persona’s API product are returned by tools/list or callable, so a Support agent never discovers — let alone calls — a confidential insights tool.
onViolation: HTTP 401 InvalidApiKeyForGivenResource — tool hidden from tools/list, tools/call rejected

policies.name: VA-VerifyAPIKey
policies.purpose: Matches the MCP operation against the key’s API product; tools not on the product are filtered or rejected.

title: Tool Call Rate Limits
summary: Caps tool-call rates per app and per tool, from the quota on the API product, so a runaway agent loop cannot overwhelm core customer or order systems.

policies.name: Q-Limit
policies.purpose: Enforces the product quota (per app and per tool) protecting downstream systems of record.

title: MCP Server Call & Audit Log
summary: Strips client credentials, forwards the call to the MCP server (Apigee-hosted Customer Service, Business Insights and industry packs, Google’s BigQuery, or third-party such as ServiceNow), and streams an audit record of every tool invocation to Cloud Logging.

policies.name: AM-RemoveAuthorization
policies.purpose: Strips client auth headers before forwarding to the MCP server.

policies.name: ML-CloudLogging
policies.purpose: Streams structured MCP tool execution audit logs to Google Cloud Logging.

title: JSON-RPC → REST Bridge (Optional)
summary: Only for REST APIs converted to MCP and hosted by Apigee: maps the tool call to the REST endpoint and validates arguments against the tool schema. Third-party MCP servers skip it.

policies.name: PP-MCP
policies.purpose: Maps the MCP tool name and JSON arguments to the target URL, HTTP verb, and parameters.

policies.name: RF-RefundLimit
policies.purpose: Business rule on the REST proxy: issueRefund over $50 returns HTTP 403 REFUND_LIMIT for every persona.
